response.text:
RedPal - Know What's Real on Reddit

on Reddit

RedPal instantly analyzes Reddit comments to detect AI-generated content, verify truthfulness, and filter out low-quality posts. Browse with confidence.

Privacy-focused No data collection 100% free

## Powerful Features

Everything you need to navigate Reddit with confidence and clarity

### AI Detection

Instantly identify AI-generated comments using advanced machine learning algorithms. Know when you're reading human vs. bot content.

### Truth Verification

Cross-reference claims with reliable sources to verify factual accuracy. Stop misinformation in its tracks.

### Quality Analysis

Filter out spam, trolls, and low-effort posts. Get quality signals on every comment thread instantly.

### Real-Time Scanning

Automatic analysis as you browse. No clicking, no waiting - just instant insights on every Reddit page.

## How It Works

Get started in seconds, no setup required

1

### Install Extension

Add RedPal to Chrome in one click. No signup, no configuration needed.

2

### Browse Reddit

Visit any Reddit thread as usual. RedPal works automatically in the background.

3

### Get Instant Insights

See color-coded badges on comments showing AI detection, quality scores, and truth ratings.

This is a genuine, well-researched comment...

## Ready to Browse Reddit with Confidence?

Join thousands of Redditors who trust RedPal to keep their feeds clean and authentic.
